status: placeholder: no band is set. The analysis makes no energy statement until a band is filled from a cited measurement.

how_to_fill.band: {"low": <J per token>, "high": <J per token>} with 0 < low <= high; input = prefill (per input token), output = decode (per output token, reasoning included); leave a kind null if it is not modelled, and the analysis then states nothing for conditions read or built by that profile
how_to_fill.source: required once any band of the profile is set: the measurement (e.g. ML.ENERGY leaderboard entry or TokenPowerBench row: model, hardware, batch size, date, URL)
how_to_fill.basis: how the band was derived from the source (hardware assumed for the tier, batch-size range, PUE included or not)
candidate_sources: EcoLogits (cheapest estimator baseline: output tokens only)
how_to_fill.statement_rule: energy per query = input tokens x input band + output tokens x output band (+ build tokens / N on the builder's bands); A < B is stated only when A's high end is below B's low end
